note: Operability. Wire: dispatch futures shrink (no debug block_on boxing); optional request fields remote_addr and scheme surface as ConnectInfo<SocketAddr> and Extension<Scheme>; Rust panics flag metadata.panicked. JNI: shutdown0 / VesperaBridge.shutdown(Duration) stops the shared runtime, later dispatches answer 503. Bridge: request ids (vespera.bridge.request-id.*, MDC requestId, echoed header); WARN logs for panics and 5xx; DispatchObserver SPI plus an optional Micrometer timer vespera.bridge.dispatch; vespera.bridge.library-name auto-init and opt-in shutdown-on-close; actionable error for a library already loaded in another classloader; prefix servlet mappings and ;path parameters are stripped from the forwarded path; ASYNC returns ResponseEntity<byte[]> (no Range handling); proxy-generated errors are text/plain like error_wire and the unknown-app 404 no longer echoes the app name. Gradle plugin: macOS detected before Windows, cargoBuild never UP-TO-DATE and ignores target/node_modules/.git, missing Cargo.lock accepted, extraNativeLibs and targets for multi-platform jars (cargoBuild is now a CargoBuildTask instead of Exec).
